newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Futures drive S.Africa industrials to close higher.
newsitem.headline: Futures drive S.Africa industrials to close higher.

text.p: Spending much of the day languishing around fairly firm levels attained in the morning, South African industrial shares pushed up in afternoon trade, driven by futures players and strong institutional interest.
The industrial index ended what dealers called a "hectic" day nearly one percent higher.
Dealers said lines of select stocks were traded and that this hinted at institutional activity.
They added that trade was characterised by such institutional interest as well as by busy futures trade which saw futures players buy stocks and sell the underlying futures.
Morning trade was fairly hushed in typical pre-Christmas lethargy but activity picked up substantially later.
Technical and mining and exploration stocks featured.
Gold shares struggled higher throguhoiut the day after starting on a dip below open, weighed by listless bullion.
Still they closed a tad better.
Industrials rose 77 points to 7,897.4, all-shares were up 51.2 points at 6,666.4 and golds added 8.6 points to 1,526.4.
